description: Live Cursor token billing in the status bar. Individual plans show a double usage ring; Team and Enterprise use the same kaomoji and allowance alerts when the summary returns included dollars. Costs use API-reported cents only.
config.title: Cursor Token Usage
config.displayCount: How many recent usage rows to show in the details panel (does not limit the trend chart)
config.pollingInterval: Seconds to wait after a poll finishes; may increase while unfocused or after failures
config.showStatusBar: Show usage on the status bar
config.statusBarAlignment: Status bar side: left or right
config.alertThreshold.newSession: Alert after this many newly observed requests; background polls inspect up to 100 events
config.alertThreshold.overallSpending: Alert when included spend rises by this many dollars
config.alertThreshold.cursorModels: Alert when the Cursor Models pool rises by this many percent
config.alertThreshold.otherModels: Alert when the Other Models pool rises by this many percent
config.alertThreshold.onDemandSpending: Alert when on-demand spend rises by this many dollars
config.alertThreshold.totalTokens: Alert when total tokens rise by this amount
config.budgetAmount: Dollar amount for the amount alert; 0 disables that alert. Cursor Models and Other Models still alert at 50%, 80% and 100% while usage alerts are on.
config.budgetMetric: Amount-alert basis: onDemand for on-demand spending, included for included-usage dollars. Uses API-reported amounts only.
